titel: Brown sugar from sugar and molasses
kurz: Brown sugar is white sugar with a little molasses. The molasses brings aroma, moisture and a little acidity.
bild_im_kopf: Like a white shirt dipped in tea: the shirt is the same, but now it has colour and flavour.
haltbarkeit: Keeps a long time airtight. If it has gone hard: put it in the tin overnight with a piece of bread.
material: 1 tbsp molasses for light, 2 tbsp for dark sugar
bowl and fork, or food processor
verwendung: Chewy cookies and brownies: they stay softer.
With baking soda in a batter: the slight acidity of the molasses helps it rise.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Add the molasses to the sugar and work it in with a fork
schluesselmomente.warum: The molasses coats every crystal with a thin film.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Mix until the colour is even
schluesselmomente.warum: Molasses is sugar syrup with the aroma compounds and minerals left over from refining.
Molasses attracts moisture: the sugar stays soft and makes baked goods moister.
